_doc: PENDING S6 semantic conformance obligations — NOT YET WIRED. These describe the SEMANTIC / POSTURE obligations the S6 stories (F-10 upload resume; F-12 cold-boot safety + opt-in auto-run; F-18 BLE pairing baseline + single-writer) must satisfy. F-11 (multi-file reliability bench) is NOT here: it is an executable HIL bench (hil/f11_reliability_bench.py), authored NOW because its wire (§5 windowed upload) is FROZEN and it owes no firmware [green]. The three entries below carry NO frame_hex ON PURPOSE. Their inputs are POSTURE/SEMANTICS freezes that are still DRAFT in the working tree (2026-07-01): (a) protocol.md §5 'Resume on reconnect' explicitly reads 'full behaviour lands later' — the resume_offset FIELD LAYOUT is frozen (§5), the resume BEHAVIOUR is not; (b) protocol.md §10 Security is the LAST DRAFT wire section (freeze ledger line 21: '§10 Security | DRAFT'); (c) OI-5 is OPEN (specs.md §10 OI-5: the auto_run caps flag position AND a SET_AUTORUN opcode number 'MUST be fixed in protocol.md §7/§4 before F-12 implementation') — there is literally no SET_AUTORUN opcode number to encode. Fabricating any of these bytes/semantics would REDEFINE draft wire — forbidden (wire is referenced, never redefined; SDD: no [red] before the spec section is FROZEN). Each entry states the frozen SEMANTIC obligation and the EXACT freeze it is BLOCKED on. When the three [docs] freezes land, firmware-test-author promotes the frame-level vectors into corpus.json and authors the HIL probes. This is the S2->S3->S4->S5 pattern: see s5_pending.json.

_blocked_on.protocol.md_§5_resume_behaviour: FREEZE the §5 'Resume on reconnect' paragraph from 'full behaviour lands later' to a stamped behaviour: FILE_PUT_BEGIN{total,crc,path} with an existing jailed <dest>.pbltmp returns resume_offset = the VERIFIED contiguous temp prefix length the board itself wrote (re-CRC temp[0,len) to re-seed the running whole-file CRC + set watermark=len); the app resumes FILE_PUT_DATA from resume_offset; FILE_PUT_END whole-file CRC over [0,total) is the ONLY correctness gate; guard temp_len>total -> truncate to 0 / resume_offset=0; no temp -> resume_offset=0. Wire UNCHANGED (RSP stays [status](+[resume_offset:u32])).
_blocked_on.specs.md_FR-FS-7_semantics: specs.md FR-FS-7 currently states the requirement but must carry the FROZEN semantics stamp mirroring the §5 resume behaviour (verified-prefix, never-restart-by-default, ECRC-keeps-old-file) before any F-10 [red].
_blocked_on.protocol.md_§10_security: STAMP protocol.md §10 Security FROZEN (last DRAFT wire section). Baseline: BLE link-layer pairing/encryption ENABLED + USED when the central initiates (NimBLE SM Just-Works, io_cap NO_INPUT_OUTPUT, LE-SC on, bonding on, MITM off). RULING (available-and-used, NOT access-gating): encryption SUPPORTED but NOT mandatory-per-characteristic — RX/TX/INFO MUST NOT set F_READ_ENC/F_WRITE_ENC; a normal central (PyBLE app + bleak/CoreBluetooth on macOS, the HIL harness) MUST still connect + exchange PBLE/1. No app-layer auth (SEC-2, connected client trusted). No wire opcode/field change — pairing is link-layer, single-writer is agent-internal.
_blocked_on.specs.md_§9_SEC_freeze: specs.md §9 Security (SEC-1..11) is DRAFT (specs.md ledger line 17). Mirror/FREEZE the §10 posture: SEC-1 baseline pairing; SEC-2 no app-layer auth; SEC-3 single active writer (READ ops non-writers; MUTATING file ops + RUN control serialized); SEC-5/8 adv = Service UUID + name only, no PII/telemetry; SEC-7/10/11 never gate/branch trust on MAC/device_id/label.
_blocked_on.OI-5_autorun_wire: protocol.md §7 must add the auto_run caps field (u8: 0=off default, 1=on) at a protocol-owner-fixed position (additive, older clients ignore per §9) AND §4 must add a SET_AUTORUN opcode [enable:u8] -> RSP[status] at a protocol-owner-fixed number (unknown-op stays safe -> EUNSUPPORTED). This is the HARD F-12 DoR blocker — there is no opcode number to encode until it lands.
_blocked_on.specs.md_§4.7_boot_freeze: specs.md §4.7 FR-BOOT-1..6, §4.8 FR-MODE-1/4, NFR-SAFE-3 are authored but under the DRAFT §4 Functional block (specs.md ledger line 15). Stamp FROZEN: NVS namespace 'pyble' key 'autorun' (u8) persistence; entry /main.py at fs_root; boot lifecycle order; fail-safe (auto-run onto the runner WORKER, advertising already live).

_frozen_frame_level_promotable_now: ONE S6 vector is already frame-level frozen and MAY be promoted into corpus.json independent of the behaviour freezes: a FILE_PUT_BEGIN RSP carrying [status=OK][resume_offset:u32 != 0] — the §5 RSP LAYOUT is frozen, so the FRAME CODEC + CRC + fragmentation of a non-zero-resume RSP is testable as an opaque-payload vector. It is deliberately NOT added here yet: (a) the S5 §5 frozen frame-level FS vectors (0x10..0x1A, 0x41) are themselves not yet promoted into corpus.json (see s5_pending.json), so S6 promotion follows that; (b) adding it before the resume BEHAVIOUR freezes risks implying resume semantics are frozen. Promote it together with the S5 FS frame-level batch on the §5-resume [docs] stamp.
_host_vs_hil: SPLIT (ADR-0006 native-C reality). F-10 pble_fs resume, F-12 pble_boot lifecycle/auto-run, F-18 pble_ble SM + pble_lock single-writer are NATIVE C — there is NO host-importable Python module to unit-test on CPython. So the host-runnable-NOW S6 slice is only: (a) the shared FRAME-CODEC corpus still byte-verifying (test_pyble_proto) + the HIL harness codec matching it byte-for-byte (test_hil_wire); (b) the no-leak clean-room grep over the new test files. Native-C UNIT coverage (resume-prefix re-CRC, autorun NVS get/set, pble_lock W_RUN/W_XFER independence, errno tables) is Unity-on-native and arrives with F-20. ALL of F-10 resume-across-drop, F-12 cold-boot fail-safe, F-18 pairing/single-writer behaviour is HIL on ESP32-S3 (UART REPL + bleak central). See gates/g1_s6_check.sh.

pending_vectors.name: put_begin_resume_offset_verified_prefix
pending_vectors.obligation: A FILE_PUT_BEGIN{total,crc,path} for a path that already holds a VERIFIED partial temp prefix (<dest>.pbltmp) MUST return resume_offset = the board-verified contiguous prefix length (>0), re-seeding the running whole-file CRC over temp[0,resume_offset) and setting watermark=resume_offset, so the app resumes FILE_PUT_DATA from there rather than restarting at 0 (FR-FS-7, NFR-REL-2). Wire is UNCHANGED — the RSP stays [status](+[resume_offset:u32]); only the VALUE/behaviour is new.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (resume_offset>0 RSP layout, already §5-frozen) + HIL (byte-exact resume after a real drop)

pending_vectors.name: resume_completes_after_drop_no_corruption_no_dup
pending_vectors.obligation: After a mid-PUT link drop, the <dest>.pbltmp + watermark MUST PERSIST on flash while the in-RAM transfer state resets (pble_fs_on_disconnect). On reconnect, FILE_PUT_BEGIN returns resume_offset>0, the app sends only the remaining bytes, and FILE_PUT_END's whole-file CRC over [0,total) gates OK — the finished file MUST be byte-identical to a non-interrupted upload (no corruption) and MUST NOT duplicate the resumed prefix (NFR-REL-2/3, FR-FS-14).
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (simulate a drop mid-transfer, reconnect, resume, whole-file CRC + byte-compare)

pending_vectors.name: resume_bad_or_foreign_prefix_ecrc_keeps_old_file
pending_vectors.obligation: A resumed transfer whose whole-file CRC does NOT match at FILE_PUT_END MUST return ECRC (0x08); the temp is deleted and the PRE-EXISTING dest file is KEPT byte-for-byte (never restarts from zero by default, never silently corrupts/duplicates) (FR-FS-14, NFR-REL-3). Guard: a temp longer than the new total_size MUST truncate to 0 and report resume_offset=0.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (ECRC RSP) + HIL (corrupt/foreign prefix -> ECRC, old file intact)

pending_vectors.name: cold_boot_advertise_and_wait_no_autorun_default
pending_vectors.obligation: On power-up the agent MUST initialize, start BLE advertising, and WAIT for a connection BEFORE any user code, and by DEFAULT (auto_run=0) MUST NOT auto-run /main.py — RUN_STATE reports idle, agent mode, regardless of workspace contents (FR-BOOT-1/2, FR-MODE-1/4, NFR-SAFE-3). The frozen _boot.py already advertises-and-waits; F-12 adds only the opt-in path, defaulting off.
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (cold boot with a present /main.py: board advertises + connectable + RUN_STATE idle, main.py NOT executed)

pending_vectors.name: autorun_optin_flag_persisted_and_surfaced
pending_vectors.opcode: SET_AUTORUN (OI-5, number TBD) + auto_run cap (OI-5, position TBD)
pending_vectors.obligation: Auto-run MUST be OPT-IN only, gated behind an explicit capability flag (auto_run) surfaced in DEVICE_INFO/HELLO and persisted in NVS (namespace 'pyble', key 'autorun', u8). A NEW additive SET_AUTORUN[enable:u8]->RSP[status] opcode sets it; an unknown-op on an older agent stays safe (EUNSUPPORTED) (FR-BOOT-3). When enabled AND /main.py exists at fs_root, boot hands it to the runner WORKER as RUN{file:/main.py}.
pending_vectors.note: NO opcode number exists until the OI-5 §7/§4 additive [docs] amendment lands — cannot encode a SET_AUTORUN frame; strictly blocked.
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (SET_AUTORUN RSP + auto_run caps byte, once numbered) + HIL (set flag, reboot, /main.py runs on the worker)

pending_vectors.name: broken_or_looping_main_still_advertises_failsafe
pending_vectors.obligation: With auto-run ENABLED, a syntactically broken OR infinite-loop /main.py MUST NOT prevent advertising or connection: advertising is already live before any user code, auto-run runs on the runner WORKER (never the host/main task), so a wedged main.py only occupies the worker — STOP still works, the link + REPL stay up (FR-BOOT-4/6, NFR-SAFE-3). A control-plane fault MUST fail safe to advertising (the _boot.py agent block stays inside its try/except), never wedge the board; the agent never depends on an editable boot.py/main.py (FR-BOOT-5, ADR-0006 firmware-embedded).
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (flash a `while True: pass` /main.py with auto-run on: board still advertises + connectable + STOP interrupts it; then a SyntaxError /main.py: RUN_STATE(error), agent up)

pending_vectors.name: pairing_encryption_active_but_not_access_gating
pending_vectors.obligation: BLE link-layer pairing/encryption MUST be the security baseline (NimBLE SM Just-Works, io_cap NO_INPUT_OUTPUT, LE-SC on, bonding on, MITM off), ENABLED and USED when the central initiates (SEC-1). RULING (available-and-used, NOT access-gating): encryption is SUPPORTED but NOT mandatory-per-characteristic — RX/TX/INFO MUST NOT set BLE_GATT_CHR_F_READ_ENC/F_WRITE_ENC; a normal central (the PyBLE app AND bleak/CoreBluetooth on macOS, the HIL harness) MUST still connect + exchange PBLE/1 unblocked. No app-layer auth; a connected client is trusted (SEC-2). Mandatory-per-char encryption is REJECTED for v1 (breaks 'just connect and use').
pending_vectors.verify: HIL (bleak/CoreBluetooth central connects, negotiates encryption when it initiates, and completes a full PBLE/1 HELLO+FILE round-trip WITHOUT being locked out by an ENC-required characteristic)

pending_vectors.name: single_active_writer_serialized_run_and_file_ops
pending_vectors.obligation: The agent MUST enforce a SINGLE active writer: only ONE user program runs at a time (2nd RUN -> EBUSY, governed by the runner run-state) and MUTATING file ops (PUT/DELETE/MKDIR/RENAME) + RUN control are serialized via a centralized token (pble_lock: W_RUN/W_XFER). READ ops (LIST/STAT/GET) are non-writers. RULING: W_RUN and W_XFER are INDEPENDENT so run-while-upload works (jail + atomic temp-rename make the bridge non-corrupting, FR-FS-16); a 2nd of the SAME class -> EBUSY (0x07). The token releases on op completion AND on disconnect (a dropped upload frees W_XFER for a resuming reconnect — couples F-18 to F-10); a genuinely-running program persists across disconnect (SEC-3, FR-FS-16).
pending_vectors.verify: conformance (EBUSY RSP on a 2nd same-class writer, §8-frozen) + HIL (concurrent 2nd PUT -> EBUSY; concurrent 2nd RUN -> EBUSY; a PUT + a RUN coexist; disconnect frees W_XFER)

pending_vectors.name: no_mac_gating_no_telemetry_no_pii_adv
pending_vectors.obligation: Identity MUST be DISPLAY-ONLY: the agent MUST NOT gate access, authorize commands, or branch its trust model on MAC/device_id/label — FILE_*/RUN/control ops behave IDENTICALLY with or without a label set (SEC-7/11). The advertisement MUST carry only the Service UUID + name (PyBLE-XXXX default or the set label), no PII by default (SEC-5/10). NO telemetry: all user content (workspace files, console output) stays on-device; the agent MUST NOT transmit anything off-device by default (SEC-8). SET_LABEL/SET_IDENTIFY_LED/IDENTIFY are ordinary commands under connected-client trust.
pending_vectors.note: the f11 reliability bench --relabel flag already exercises the SEC-11 'label never gates access' half at the FILE level; the adv-content (no PII) + no-telemetry halves are HIL scan/sniff observations.
pending_vectors.verify: unit (structure: no MAC/label branch in the access path) + HIL (scan shows only UUID+name; uploads identical pre/post SET_LABEL; no unsolicited off-device traffic)
